name: decisions
description: A decision log in .decisions, written as the decisions are made, in the repositories that ask for one

interface.shortDescription: Decisions, recorded as they are made
interface.longDescription: A repository that opts in gets .decisions/ at its root, one file per topic, and the agent appends to it while it works: the question, the answer, the reason argued, and each rejected option with what killed it. The directory is the switch, so a repository without one is never written to, and turning the log off leaves everything already recorded where it is. A Stop hook says once when a session settled something and wrote none of it down.
capabilities: Turn the decision log on for a repository, and say whether git will commit it
Turn it off without deleting anything already recorded
Append a decision to the file for its topic while the work happens
Notice at the end of a session that nothing was recorded, and say so once
defaultPrompt: Turn the decision log on for this repository.
Record why we picked system git over brew git.
Stop logging decisions here, but keep the ones we have.
